subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• In 2021, biology students at Duke and UNC developed a virtual reality experience to teach concepts about coral reef ecosystems.
• Their "Reef Explorer" program featured an immersive 3D underwater environment with different reef zones.
• Users were encouraged to navigate to a zone of their choice and interact with marine life in that area.
• One touch allowed them to access detailed information, videos, and animations about the selected organisms.
• The program was effective with students because the format helped them retain complex ecological relationships.
prompt: The student wants to explain an advantage of the "Reef Explorer" format. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The "Reef Explorer" format benefited students because it helped them retain complex ecological relationships.
choices.B: "Reef Explorer" featured a 3D underwater environment with different reef zones, each containing interactive marine life.
choices.C: To access detailed information, videos, and animations, users had to first interact with an organism.
choices.D: Using a virtual reality format, biology students at Duke and UNC created "Reef Explorer," a program about coral reef ecosystems.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence explains an advantage of the "Reef Explorer" format, noting that the format benefited students because it helped them retain complex ecological relationships.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence describes the 3D environment in the "Reef Explorer" program; it doesn't explain an advantage of the program's format.
